# AG ADS (Advanced Growth)

> Premier Integrated Marketing & Advertising Agency in Puducherry and Chennai. One Brand. Every Channel. Real Growth.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: AG ADS (Advanced Growth)
- **Primary Specialization**: Integrated Marketing combining performance digital advertising with commanding physical outdoor media.
- **Operating Locations**: Puducherry, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and regional South India.
- **Official Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 6369846324
- **Official Instagram**: [@ag.ads.pondy](https://instagram.com/ag.ads.pondy)

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Digital Marketing Services
- **Meta Ads & Performance Marketing**: Precision targeted Facebook and Instagram campaign creation, lead generation, ROAS scaling, audience lookalikes, conversion funnels.
- **Google Ads & Search Marketing**: High-intent Google Search, Performance Max, Display Network, YouTube pre-roll ads, local search map optimizations.
- **Social Media Management**: Editorial calendar, social copy, reel creation, engagement strategies, community management.
- **Creative Branding & Graphic Design**: Brand identity, corporate style guides, logomarks, packaging, digital banners, marketing collateral.
- **Website Development**: High-performance, SEO-optimized, accessible corporate and campaign web platforms.

### 2. AG Production Studio
- **Content Shooting**: High-end product shoots, lifestyle photography, behind-the-scenes (BTS) media.
- **Content Creation**: High-converting creative concepts, viral reel scripting, storytelling frameworks.
- **Videography**: Cinematic brand commercials, event coverage, client case studies, executive interviews.
- **Video Editing**: Color grading, motion graphics, sound design, multi-platform vertical & horizontal aspect formatting.

### 3. Outdoor & Transit Advertising
- **LED Video Van Advertising**: Dynamic mobile digital display units equipped with high-brightness LED video screens navigating high-traffic corridors across Puducherry and Chennai.
- **Billboards & Hoardings**: Prime landmark placement on highways, arterial roads, junctions, and commercial centers.
- **Sun-Pack Advertising**: Pole kiosks, street fixtures, and residential community branding.
- **Transit & Vehicle Branding**: Auto rickshaw wraps, bus panels, fleet advertising.
- **Traditional Mass Media**: Newspaper inserts/display, regional FM Radio campaigns, television broadcast ads.
